description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'EditorFileReference' that provides a filter to track images uploaded via a Text Editor, updating file URLs and cache tags, and setting image dimensions to prevent layout shifts.

classes.name: EditorFileReference
classes.description: A Drupal filter plugin class that tracks uploaded images in text editor content, updating URLs, cache tags, and image dimensions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity repository and image factory dependencies.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the input text to update image URLs, set image dimensions, and add cache tags for referenced files.
